title: It deletes the history files after updating to 0.45.2

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides specific reproduction steps and context regarding history session files being deleted upon using /exit or /quit in CLI version 0.45.2, affecting session resumption via gemini --resume.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Investigating and fixing automatic session cleanup logic involves state management and asynchronous background retention checks across packages/cli (sessionCleanup.ts, sessionUtils.ts, gemini.tsx) to ensure valid session files in project temp directories are preserved.

summary.problem: After executing /exit or /quit in CLI version 0.45.2, session history files in .gemini/tmp/projname are deleted, preventing session resumption using gemini --resume.
summary.root_cause: Automatic session cleanup in packages/cli/src/utils/sessionCleanup.ts triggered during CLI lifecycle misidentifies valid session files as corrupted or expired, or purges session directory artifacts when exiting.
summary.context: Session retention settings are managed via settings.general.sessionRetention. When /exit or /quit is run or during startup, cleanupExpiredSessions scans session files in .gemini/tmp/projname/chats. If session file parsing or retention rules misclassify valid session entries, files are unlinked and session directories removed.

steps: Inspect session file parsing and short-ID matching in packages/cli/src/utils/sessionCleanup.ts to ensure valid JSON/JSONL session files are not misclassified as corrupted (sessionInfo === null).
Verify identifySessionsToDelete to ensure active and recent sessions are properly preserved according to session retention policies.
Ensure cleanupSessionAndSubagentsAsync and session storage routines under .gemini/tmp/projname/chats correctly preserve active session data during /exit or /quit execution.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Executing /exit or /quit and running cleanupExpiredSessions preserves active session history files and enables session resumption via gemini --resume.
verification_steps: Add unit test cases confirming that active session files and directories are retained after session cleanup is invoked.
